title: Commander George Hoover on aliens saying 'you don't know how powerful you are'

tellings.quote: or Commander George Hoover of the Navy actually talked about this. Aliens often come down, they say, you don't know how powerful you are.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a US Navy officer, Commander George Hoover, talked about aliens who come down and tell people, "you don't know how powerful you are." Michels raises it as a hint that, if true, these beings see some hidden power in humans that we don't recognize in ourselves.
